newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh customs seizes gold worth $1.8 million.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh customs seizes gold worth $1.8 million.

text.p: Bangladesh customs officials have seized smuggled gold worth about $1.8 million at Dhaka airport in the country's biggest haul, officials said on Sunday.
The officials said 1,175 bars of gold weighing about 137 kg (301.4 lb) were brought in from Singapore as unaccompanied baggage on Thursday by Bangladesh Biman Airlines.
The officials said the gold, concealed in two cartons of electronic goods, was sent from Bridge Road in Singapore to a business firm in Dhaka which, they said, does not exist.
